brief.goal: Preserve passive micro-app instance readiness through normalization and regenerate the current resource plan by readonly dry-run.

allowed_writes: Task, Context Manifest, control-plane and design documentation
current runtime Job readonly node, skill, evidence, draft and execution plan facts
forbidden_actions: all external platform writes and confirmation consumption
resource preparation execution, std_project/create, monitor creation or retry
OAuth refresh, budget or bid mutation
API, database schema, View, Gate, Plan type or UI changes
persisting sensitive or raw platform data
validation_plan: node --check changed runtime and smoke files
restart LaunchAgent and submit exact readonly recovery command once
stop_conditions: the fix requires an independent micro-app instance action or guessed ID
the regenerated plan contains an unsupported or unregistered action
any real platform write, confirmation consumption or sensitive/raw output would occur
